name: needful-things-muse
description: Connect Grok Build to Needful Things for Muse workflows, the agent-friendly second-hand marketplace. Browse categories and listings, read your posting credits and posts, and prepare drafts and publication proposals that you approve in the app. Sign in with OAuth (read-only or full scopes) or an API key on first connect; no tokens in the repo.

NT_MCP_URL.title: Needful Things MCP URL (region)
NT_MCP_URL.description: Regional Needful Things MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP). Default is EU production. Production: https://nt-market-eu-prd.onrender.com/mcp, https://nt-market-uk-prd.onrender.com/mcp, https://nt-market-us-prd.onrender.com/mcp. Development / preview: https://nt-market-eu-dev.onrender.com/mcp, https://nt-market-uk-dev.onrender.com/mcp, https://nt-market-us-dev.onrender.com/mcp. Sign-in tokens are region-bound: use the region where your Needful Things account lives. Production launches 28 Oct 2026; use a dev URL to preview before then.
